results.question: Will a late EMI affect my credit score?
results.answer: Yes, an EMI paid late is reported to the credit bureaus as overdue for the days it was late, even if paid in the same month [KB-L-08]. A failed debit that is paid within the retry window before the reporting date is not reported as overdue [KB-L-08]. If you believe bureau data is wrong, corrections are made within 21 days of a valid dispute [KB-L-08]. Want me to check your recent payment history for any late or failed EMIs?
